description: This file defines a TelemetryClient class for handling telemetry events, along with related constants and interfaces, for tracking user interactions within a web application related to boards and cards.

classes.name: TelemetryClient
classes.description: A class for managing telemetry event tracking, including setting user and handler, and recording events and page visits.

methods.name: setTelemetryHandler
methods.description: Sets the telemetry handler used for tracking events.

methods.name: setUser
methods.description: Assigns a user object to the telemetry client.

methods.name: trackEvent
methods.description: Tracks a telemetry event with specified category, event name, and optional properties.

methods.name: pageVisited
methods.description: Records a page visit event with category and name.
